title: The Tortoise and the Hare
moral: Keep going, step by step, and you can reach places you never thought you could; and a kind friend cheers for you whether you win or lose.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Once upon a time, in a sunny meadow at the edge of the Whispering Wood, lived two neighbours who were as different as can be.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, a little bouncy
lines.text: Hattie the Hare was quick and bouncy. She could hop over a log before you could even say hop!

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: excited, playful, full of energy, proud but friendly
lines.text: Wheee! Look at me! I'm the fastest hopper in the whole wide wood!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, slowing down
lines.text: And Toby the Tortoise was slow and calm. He liked to sit in the warm sun and watch the daisies sway.

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: slow, calm, kind, a gentle smile in the voice
lines.text: Good morning, sunshine. Good morning, daisies.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: bright, teasing but not mean, a little cheeky
lines.text: Good morning, Toby! Goodness, you're slow. Do you ever actually get anywhere?

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: calm, steady, patient, not hurt
lines.text: I always get where I'm going, Hattie. One step, and then another step.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: laughing lightly, playful
lines.text: One step at a time? I can do a hundred hops in that time!

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: sudden bright idea, excited
lines.text: I know! Let's have a race! Then everyone will see who is the fastest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Toby thought for a moment. Then he smiled a slow, steady smile.

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: calm, friendly, quietly confident
lines.text: All right, Hattie. Let's race.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, lively
lines.text: News of the race spread through the meadow faster than a breeze.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Pip the Squirrel came scampering down from the trees, and Bramble the Hedgehog came trundling out of the ferns.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.performance_direction: squeaky, excited, quick
lines.text: A race! A race! Hattie against Toby!

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.performance_direction: slow, cosy, a little fussy, kind
lines.text: Oh my, oh my. I must find a good place to watch.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Wise old Olive the Owl fluffed her feathers and hooted for quiet.

lines.speaker: OLIVE
lines.performance_direction: wise, clear, kind, like a friendly teacher
lines.text: The race goes along the forest path, up the hill past the big shady tree, and all the way to the daisy ribbon by the old oak.

lines.speaker: OLIVE
lines.performance_direction: clear and exciting, building up
lines.text: Racers, take your places. Ready... steady... go!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, fast and fun
lines.text: Whoosh! Hattie shot off like an arrow.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, slow and warm
lines.text: And Toby? Toby took one careful step. And then another.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.performance_direction: squeaky, cheering
lines.text: Go, Toby, go!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Hattie raced along the forest path, past the ferns and the mushrooms and the mossy stones.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: After a while, she stopped and looked back. There was no one there at all.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: pleased with herself, laughing
lines.text: Ha! Toby's so far behind, I can't even see him!

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: smug, relaxed
lines.text: This race is too easy.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: At the top of the hill stood a big shady tree, with soft cool grass all around it.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: sleepy, content, yawning a little
lines.text: Mmm, this looks comfy. I have plenty of time. I'll rest my eyes for just one minute.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, soft and sleepy
lines.text: Hattie lay down in the shade. She yawned a great big yawn...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, whispering
lines.text: ...and before she knew it, she was fast asleep.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Meanwhile, back on the forest path, Toby kept walking.

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: steady, rhythmic, calm, almost a little song
lines.text: One step, and then another step. One step, and then another step.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: The sun climbed high in the sky. Toby's legs felt tired, but he did not stop.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.performance_direction: squeaky, encouraging
lines.text: You can do it, Toby! Keep going!

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: warm, grateful, determined
lines.text: Thank you, Pip. I'm not fast, but I'm not stopping.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Up, up the hill went Toby, slow and steady.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: At the top, he saw Hattie, curled up asleep under the big shady tree.

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: whispering softly, kind
lines.text: Sleep well, Hattie. I'll keep going.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, quiet
lines.text: And so, very quietly, Toby walked on past.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: The shadows grew long, and the air grew cool. Hattie's nose twitched. Her eyes popped open.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: waking, confused, then worried
lines.text: Oh! How long did I sleep?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, a little suspense, never scary
lines.text: She jumped up and looked down the hill. Far away, near the old oak, a little round shape was moving towards the daisy ribbon.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: alarmed but funny, not frightened
lines.text: Toby?! Oh no, oh no, oh no!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, fast
lines.text: Hattie ran faster than she had ever run before.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: At the old oak, everyone was waiting.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.performance_direction: excited, slow
lines.text: Look! Here comes someone!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.performance_direction: squeaky, overjoyed
lines.text: It's Toby! It's Toby!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, building joy
lines.text: Step by step, Toby walked right up to the daisy ribbon... and through it!

lines.speaker: OLIVE
lines.performance_direction: proud, joyful announcement
lines.text: The winner is... Toby the Tortoise!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Everyone cheered. A moment later, Hattie came racing in, puffing and panting.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: out of breath, surprised, honest
lines.text: Toby... you won.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: a little embarrassed, sincere
lines.text: I was so sure I was the fastest that I stopped trying. That wasn't very clever, was it?

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: kind, generous, warm
lines.text: You are very fast, Hattie. Faster than anyone I know.

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: gentle, simple
lines.text: I just kept going, one step at a time.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: sincere, sorry, then warm
lines.text: I'm sorry I teased you. Congratulations, Toby. You really earned it.

lines.speaker: TOBY
lines.performance_direction: friendly, inviting
lines.text: Thank you, Hattie. Next time, shall we walk the path together? You can show me all the things you see when you're zooming by.

lines.speaker: HATTIE
lines.performance_direction: happy, touched
lines.text: I'd like that. I'd like that very much.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: And from that day on, Hattie and Toby often walked the forest path together, Hattie hopping slowly, and Toby stepping steadily beside her.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Hattie learned that being fast is wonderful, but it is no good if you stop trying.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: And Toby showed everyone that when you keep going, step by step, you can reach places you never thought you could.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, the moral, slow and clear
lines.text: Slow and steady wins the race.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, closing
lines.text: The end.
